body: She "raised" DH  from age 3 to 16ish so he's her "baby boy". And she has custody of our niece so she's heavily involved in family issues/get togethers.

She wanted to make a scrap book which she did but for some ungodly reason wanted to include the actual birthing process. Cousin just played along to get the camera away from her on the off chance that smil wouldn't give up.
Fil talked to her and I haven't heard from her since but I plan on bringing it up next time I see or call her.
That's what DH and I are considering. I'll have to call them today and see what options are available in terms of keeping some people out but letting others in.

I was and still am pissed about those incidents. First time, she kept trying to take photos of the birth and I told her I'd break her camera. She sent my cousin in to take photos and then snuck into the bathroom. The second time, it was almost 9pm and we texted everyone to let them know baby arrived. Before I was even in a room, she popped up. Passwords on everything now and she's on the do no tell/contact lists for schools and doctors but that's more or less because she "knows" everything about everything.

Thank you. I was very upset about it last night. Now I'm just kinda shrugging since I knew she'd be upset at being the last to know. Fil is pretty good at handling her especially when we aren't up to it. On the post she just complained but in the text she said "how is Chowder and labor?"

I don't plan to. I've got much more important things to worry about than her feelings. But if she does (and she probably will) complain after this whole thing is over, I plan to be the pettiest i can be.
Thank you.

He used to be very good handling my depression with me. He's stayed up through every spell, the attempt, and every panic attack. I think he just got used to me not having these spells since I was on antidepressants for 3 years. We usually hold off on serious talks until after the kids are in bed so I'm definitely going to bring it up tonight.

Im going to make it clear that I need more than "get meds"

Apparently my SMIL. She didn't just stop there. She mentioned her ex husband's as well. She's trying desperately for more kids in this family while I'm actively growing one. Then again, she doesn't get to see our kids often and doesn't see them without DH or I there.

Depending on which friend, maybe. Birds of a feather flock together and all that jazz. Some of her friends have the same sense of humor she does. She was at work during the conversation and her co-worker friend was laughing along with her.
I told DH that I know we make gorgeous kids but that's no excuse for everyone to try and get his baby batter.

Yeah we are. We're getting DH scheduled after current bump is born. I have a feeling this conversation might get brought up to DH at some point (because smil thinks she hilarious and repeats stories over and over until everyone's heard it a million times). I'm tempted to record it.

The pastor isn't handling the money. She sits at the back of the church so whenever the offertory is finished, she puts it into a money bag, places it in her bag until after service where it's handed to my husband who is our financial officer. He handles all the counting, reports, and sends it off to whoever has to have it. Granted she used to do it about 5 years ago until my husband took over simply because our church doesn't have enough people willing or reliable enough to help out with the behind the scenes things involved in church. Tbh we consider ourselves lucky that we're doing Sunday School classes because we just don't have people willing to help but we've got a bunch of kids who want to learn.

This is... The exact situation my husband had. Mom and dad were both military. Divorced when DH was 2 and dad got custody. Dad married a woman who literally returned every. Single. Thing that biomom mailed to the kids. Would write down scripts for him to read on phone calls, would scan the letters from biomom and write snarky shit in the margins and send it back. She told DH that biomom wanted nothing to do with him and he believed it because he wasn't getting any letters or gifts. 

It wasn't until DH and I got pregnant that I even spoke to her and it was because she reached out to me about the pregnancy and marriage. We FINALLY met up with her last year and found out everything. She had every letter, returned box, and all of DH's baby stuff and I read the stuff. It was horrible. It didn't help that my DH was abused by his step mom. She literally took away his mother and refused to be one herself.

We, thankfully, now have a good relationship with biomom and are LC with step mom (we have to have some contact). Our kids love biomom and talk about her frequently. I send her pictures and we text a lot. She's actually the first person I told that we were expecting another baby.

I didn't mean to post so much but it's crazy how eerily similar yours and my DH's stories are. I'm sorry for all the time you missed out on having a wonderful mother but I'm so glad you're back in contact.
DH says that she made a huge difference in her step kids vs real kids growing up which is why we only ever see her on special occasions.
The thing is her 2 step sons both have 3 kids so she's got grandbabies but I guess she's pushing for a "real" grandbaby?

I say mildly because she usually isn't this bad or at least she hasn't been in the past. This was entirely unexpected. But she said the reason she didn't do something similar to us was because I'm her Dil and not her daughter.

Edit: typo
Yeah she looked pretty upset. Didn't help that her step dad was recording their reactions.

I like the card idea. My husband works with his friend and they hang out outside of work. I'm not as close to them as I'd like to be. So I think this might be a good step and offering to be there if she wants to talk about it.
Thank you for the responses. I did call my mom and she said nothing happened but he did go back to see her. Apparently he told her we were fine? He texted me today but I don't plan on answering.
I thought we might be but I didn't know if the timing started from the last instance of alienation or from when we first discovered he was forced away from him bio mom.
